newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish shares unchanged, caution ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Danish shares unchanged, caution ahead of holiday.

text.p: Danish share prices opened virtually unchanged on Thursday, with dealers predicting a rather cautious market mood with little activity ahead of Friday's national holiday when the bourse will be closed.

"Danish investors will in all probability keep a low profile as tomorrow's Great Prayer Day closure here means the Danish market cannot react to any new trends on the rather volatile U.S. market until Monday," one dealer said.
The KFX top-20 index had gained 0.02 point to 155.81 at 0710 gmt, having closed on Wednesday 1.05 point higher.
